company_notes:
Account background: Velvet Sparrow is a mid-market product analytics SaaS based in Berlin. Product team is building embedded in-app insights and an in-product assistant (support + contextual recommendations). Current stack: PostgreSQL + Elastic + proprietary event store. They want to start on Redwood Hosted API for speed but have a clear roadmap to Dedicated (reserved capacity) once throughput grows and to satisfy tighter SLAs. Key asks: EU-only data residency for user content, predictable p95 latency (<250ms for assistant in EU), ability to route traffic regionally with automatic fallback to NA during incidents, and KMS-backed encryption for keys.

POC details / notes: POC uses anonymized event snippets + a 1.2M-doc semantic index. Baseline on hosted EU region (Frankfurt) shows median ~120ms for short chat turns, p95 around 340ms during simulated peak — customer concerned about the p95 spike. We proposed: 1) tuning batching windows in Redwood Optimize; 2) Dedicated pool pinned to eu-central with autoscale headroom; 3) edge routing to pick nearest region for EU users and direct fallback to NA only on capacity exhaustion. Customer asked for cost model comparing hosted burst pricing vs modest Dedicated commit (6-12 months). They are price-sensitive but value predictable unit economics.

Security & legal: Legal flagged DPA clause (explicit EU residency + deletion timelines). Infosec requested SOC2 + ISO27001 artifacts, audit logging retention options, and support for external KMS/HSM. SE delivered SOC2 report and link to security FAQ. Legal scheduled follow-up with Redwood legal on 2026-03-18. Customer asked whether Private (VPC) deployment is necessary vs VPC-enabled Dedicated — leaning towards Dedicated with VPC peering to minimize network hops.

Quotes & direct notes: "We need to avoid surprises at p95 — our users notice spikes immediately." — Head of Product. "If Dedicated capacity reduces our per-token cost and stabilizes latency, we'll push to commit." — CTO.

Next steps (short):
- Provide Dedicated sizing recommendation (GPU count + burst headroom) and cost delta by 2026-03-13.
- Deliver detailed p95 breakdown between Frankfurt vs Dublin vs Paris test nodes.
- Legal/Privacy to exchange DPA redlines; SE to confirm KMS/HSM options and VPC peering checklist.
